# Local cache of IM first-edition lesson pages

Raw HTML snapshots of Illustrative Mathematics 6–8 Math **first edition**
lesson pages, fetched from im.kendallhunt.com. Cached because the project
derives representations and standard phrasings from these pages and the
publisher has drifted later editions to NC licenses — this pins what we
actually derived from.

**License**: the first-edition curriculum is © 2017–2019 Open Up
Resources / © 2019 Illustrative Mathematics, released under
**CC BY 4.0** (verified on-page 2026-08-26; see ../SOURCES.md). This
cache redistributes under that license with attribution. Do NOT add
pages from IM v.360 (© 2024+, CC BY-NC).

Naming: `g{grade}-u{unit}-l{lesson}.html` (grade as printed, not the
URL's 1/2/3 code).

**THE FULL FIRST-EDITION MS CATALOGUE IS CACHED** (2026-08-30): all
lessons of every unit, grades 6–8 — 423 pages, 9 units per grade,
discovered by walking each unit until its first 404. Spot-checked for
real lesson text and the on-page CC BY / Open Up Resources markers.
IM-first representation passes can now read locally.
